en.answer: In that case, since you would gain LP instead as a result of the effect of <<7463>>, the effect of <<11460>> cannot be activated.
en.question: When you would take effect damage, if you would gain LP instead as a result of the effect of <<7463>> already being applied, can you activate the effect of <<11460>> to Special Summon it?
